```{r setup}
#| include: false
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(here)

  library(dplyr)

# ---- helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------
# keep valid UTF-8 as is; re-read anything else as latin1 (e.g. "M\xc9TODOS")
fix_encoding <- function(x) {
  bad <- !is.na(x) & !validUTF8(x)
  x[bad] <- iconv(x[bad], from = "latin1", to = "UTF-8", sub = "")
  x
}
clean_utf8 <- function(df) df |> mutate(across(where(is.character), fix_encoding))

# capitalisation used for every categorical value shown on the page:
# trims spaces, turns all-caps headings ("ABSTRACT") into sentence case and
# starts every value with a capital letter, leaving acronyms (IPD, PICOS) alone
cap_first <- function(x) {
  x <- str_squish(as.character(x))
  x[x %in% c("", "NA")] <- NA_character_
  shout <- !is.na(x) & x == str_to_upper(x) & str_detect(x, "\\p{L}{5,}")
  x[shout] <- str_to_sentence(x[shout])
  if_else(is.na(x), NA_character_, paste0(str_to_upper(str_sub(x, 1, 1)), str_sub(x, 2)))
}

# sentence case for controlled vocabularies ("Living Mode Characteristics" ->
# "Living mode characteristics"); acronyms and proper nouns are kept
keep_capitalised <- c("Bayesian", "Chinese", "English", "Portuguese", "Spanish")
sentence_case <- function(x) {
  x <- cap_first(x)
  vapply(x, function(s) {
    if (is.na(s)) return(NA_character_)
    w <- str_split(s, " ")[[1]]
    if (length(w) > 1) {
      core <- str_remove_all(w[-1], "[[:punct:]]")
      lower <- str_detect(core, "^\\p{Lu}\\p{Ll}+$") & !core %in% keep_capitalised
      w[-1][lower] <- str_to_lower(w[-1][lower])
    }
    paste(w, collapse = " ")
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

dt_buttons <- function(filename_stub) {
  list(
    list(
      extend = "collection",
      text = "Download filtered",
      buttons = list(
        list(extend = "csv",   text = "CSV",   filename = filename_stub,
             exportOptions = list(columns = ":visible", modifier = list(search = "applied"))),
        list(extend = "excel", text = "Excel", filename = filename_stub,
             exportOptions = list(columns = ":visible", modifier = list(search = "applied"))),
        list(extend = "copy",  text = "Copy",
             exportOptions = list(columns = ":visible", modifier = list(search = "applied")))
      )
    ),
    list(extend = "colvis", text = "Columns")
  )
}

dt_options <- function(filename_stub, wide_cols = integer(0), page_length = 10) {
  list(
    dom = "Bfrtip",
    buttons = dt_buttons(filename_stub),
    pageLength = page_length,
    lengthMenu = list(c(10, 25, 50, 100, -1), c("10", "25", "50", "100", "All")),
    autoWidth = FALSE,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    deferRender = TRUE,
    searchDelay = 300,
    language = list(search = "Search all columns:", searchPlaceholder = "type to search"),
    columnDefs = list(list(targets = wide_cols, className = "wrap-cell"))
  )
}

github_url <- "https://github.com/KyleMorrison99/synthesis_item_bank"
github_raw <- paste0(github_url, "/raw/main/data/")
page_url   <- "https://kylemorrison99.github.io/synthesis_item_bank/"
osf_url    <- "https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/ZWCN2"
```

```{r load}
#| include: false
data <- read_csv(here("data", "item_bank_reporting_guideline_compiled.csv"),
                 locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  clean_utf8() |>
  # the Spanish PRISMA 2020 abstract checklist carries its checklist name as study_id
  mutate(study_id = recode(study_id, "yepes.nunez_2021_abstracts" = "yepes.nunez_2021"))

study <- read_csv(here("data", "item_bank_reporting_guideline.csv"),
                  locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  rename_with(str_squish) |>
  clean_utf8()

concept <- read_csv(here("data", "item_bank_reporting_guideline_concepts.csv"),
                    locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  clean_utf8() |>
  mutate(study_id = recode(study_id, "yepes.nunez_2021_abstracts" = "yepes.nunez_2021"))

# ---- guideline names -------------------------------------------------------
# short, recognisable name for each guideline ID (acronym where the guideline has one)

# one row per guideline (first publication kept) for joining attributes onto items and concepts
guideline_attrs <- study |>
  transmute(
    study_id,
    guideline_type = sentence_case(recode(str_to_lower(str_squish(guideline_extension)),
                                          origional = "original")),
    methodology = sentence_case(methodology_category),
    discipline = sentence_case(discipline),
    year = as.integer(year)
  ) |>
  distinct(study_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  left_join(guideline_names, by = "study_id") |>
  mutate(guideline_name = coalesce(guideline_name, study_id))

# ---- standardised tables (used on the page and offered as downloads) -------
items_real <- data |>
  filter(!is.na(standardised_section)) |>                                # drops "not applicable" placeholder rows
  mutate(
    language = sentence_case(language),
    standardised_section = sentence_case(standardised_section),
    section = cap_first(section),
    topic = cap_first(topic)
  )

concept_real <- concept |>
  filter(!is.na(standardised_reporting_item_elements)) |>
  mutate(
    standardised_reporting_item_elements = cap_first(standardised_reporting_item_elements),
    standardised_section = sentence_case(standardised_section),
    standardised_subsection = sentence_case(standardised_subsection)
  )

study_std <- study |>
  mutate(
    guideline_extension = sentence_case(recode(str_to_lower(str_squish(guideline_extension)), origional = "original")),
    methodology_category = sentence_case(methodology_category),
    discipline = sentence_case(discipline)
  ) |>
  left_join(guideline_names, by = "study_id") |>
  relocate(guideline_name, .after = study_id)

dl_dir <- here("data", "datapage")
dir.create(dl_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
write_csv(study_std |> select(-any_of(c("JCR", "comment"))), file.path(dl_dir, "guidelines.csv"), na = "")
write_csv(items_real |> left_join(guideline_names, by = "study_id") |> relocate(guideline_name, .after = study_id),
          file.path(dl_dir, "reporting_items.csv"), na = "")
write_csv(concept_real |> left_join(guideline_names, by = "study_id") |> relocate(guideline_name, .after = study_id),
          file.path(dl_dir, "concepts.csv"), na = "")

# ---- headline numbers ------------------------------------------------------
n_guidelines   <- n_distinct(study$study_id)
n_publications <- nrow(study)
n_checklists   <- n_distinct(data$checklist)
n_items        <- nrow(items_real)
n_items_en     <- sum(items_real$language == "English")
n_languages    <- n_distinct(items_real$language)
n_concept_inst <- nrow(concept_real)
n_concept_uniq <- n_distinct(concept_real$standardised_reporting_item_elements)
year_min <- min(study$year, na.rm = TRUE)
year_max <- max(study$year, na.rm = TRUE)
last_updated <- format(Sys.Date(), "%d %B %Y")
this_year <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")
```

```{=html}
// ---- tab navigation helpers ------------------------------------------------
window.esib = (function () {
  const hashToTab = {
    overview: "Overview", guidelines: "Guideline key", items: "Reporting items",
    concepts: "Concepts", variables: "Variables and values", cite: "Cite and reuse"
  };
  function tabLinks() { return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("#main-tabs > .nav-tabs .nav-link")); }
  function show(key) {
    const label = hashToTab[key] || key;
    const link = tabLinks().find(a => a.textContent.trim() === label);
    if (!link) return null;
    bootstrap.Tab.getOrCreateInstance(link).show();
    const pane = document.querySelector(link.getAttribute("data-bs-target"));
    const top = document.getElementById("main-tabs");
    if (top) top.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
    return pane;
  }
  function setSelect(inputId, value) {
    const sel = document.querySelector("#" + inputId + " select");
    if (sel && sel.selectize) { sel.selectize.setValue(value === null ? [] : [value]); return true; }
    return false;
  }
  function filter(key, inputId, value) {
    show(key);
    setTimeout(() => setSelect(inputId, value), 80);
  }
  function search(key, text) {
    const pane = show(key);
    if (!pane || !window.jQuery) return;
    setTimeout(() => {
      jQuery(pane).find("table").each(function () {
        if (jQuery.fn.dataTable.isDataTable(this)) jQuery(this).DataTable().search(text).draw();
      });
      jQuery(pane).find(".dataTables_filter input").val(text);
    }, 80);
  }
  function reset(key) {
    history.replaceState(null, "", "#" + key);
    location.reload();
  }
  function onKey(ev, fn) { if (ev.key === "Enter" || ev.key === " ") { ev.preventDefault(); fn(); } }
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    // keep the address bar in step with the open tab so links and reloads land on it
    tabLinks().forEach(a => a.addEventListener("shown.bs.tab", function () {
      const key = Object.keys(hashToTab).find(k => hashToTab[k] === a.textContent.trim());
      if (key) history.replaceState(null, "", "#" + key);
      if (window.jQuery && jQuery.fn.dataTable) {
        jQuery(jQuery.fn.dataTable.tables(true)).DataTable().columns.adjust();
      }
    }));
    const key = location.hash.replace("#", "");
    if (hashToTab[key]) setTimeout(() => show(key), 0);
  });
  return { show, filter, search, reset, onKey };
})();
</script>
```

## Overview

```{r overview}
section_levels <- c("Title", "Abstract", "Introduction", "Methodology", "Results", "Discussion", "Other information")

# ---- chart data -------------------------------------------------------------
per_year <- guideline_attrs |>
  count(year, name = "n") |>
  right_join(tibble(year = seq(year_min, year_max)), by = "year") |>
  mutate(n = coalesce(n, 0L)) |>
  arrange(year)

count_guidelines <- function(var) {
  guideline_attrs |>
    count(value = .data[[var]], name = "n", sort = TRUE) |>
    filter(!is.na(value))
}
by_type        <- count_guidelines("guideline_type")
by_methodology <- count_guidelines("methodology")
by_discipline  <- count_guidelines("discipline")

items_by_section <- items_real |>
  filter(language == "English") |>
  mutate(section = factor(standardised_section, levels = section_levels)) |>
  count(section, name = "items") |>
  arrange(section)

concepts_by_section <- concept_real |>
  mutate(section = factor(standardised_section, levels = section_levels)) |>
  group_by(section) |>
  summarise(instances = n(), unique = n_distinct(standardised_reporting_item_elements), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(section)

guideline_sets <- concept_real |>
  filter(study_id %in% items_real$study_id) |>
  distinct(study_id, e = standardised_reporting_item_elements)
n_sets <- n_distinct(guideline_sets$study_id)
top_concepts <- guideline_sets |>
  count(e, name = "n_guidelines", sort = TRUE) |>
  mutate(pct = 100 * n_guidelines / n_sets) |>
  slice_head(n = 15)

# ---- building blocks --------------------------------------------------------
js_str <- function(x) gsub("'", "\\\\'", x)

bar_row <- function(label, value, vmax, cls = "", wide = FALSE, suffix = NULL, action = NULL, hint = NULL) {
  div(class = paste("bar-row", if (wide) "wide-label", if (!is.null(action)) "clickable"),
      onclick = action,
      onkeydown = if (!is.null(action)) sprintf("esib.onKey(event, function(){ %s })", action),
      tabindex = if (!is.null(action)) "0",
      role = if (!is.null(action)) "button",
      title = hint,
      span(class = "bar-label", label),
      span(class = "bar-track", span(class = paste("bar-fill", cls), style = sprintf("width:%.1f%%", 100 * value / vmax))),
      span(class = "bar-val", format(value, big.mark = ","), if (!is.null(suffix)) tags$small(suffix)))
}

bar_row_stacked <- function(label, v1, v2, vmax, action = NULL, hint = NULL) {
  div(class = paste("bar-row", if (!is.null(action)) "clickable"),
      onclick = action,
      onkeydown = if (!is.null(action)) sprintf("esib.onKey(event, function(){ %s })", action),
      tabindex = if (!is.null(action)) "0",
      role = if (!is.null(action)) "button",
      title = hint,
      span(class = "bar-label", label),
      span(class = "bar-track stacked",
           span(class = "lane", span(class = "bar-fill", style = sprintf("width:%.1f%%", 100 * v1 / vmax))),
           span(class = "lane", span(class = "bar-fill teal", style = sprintf("width:%.1f%%", 100 * v2 / vmax)))),
      span(class = "bar-val", format(v1, big.mark = ","), tags$small(paste0("/ ", v2))))
}

guideline_bar_card <- function(title, df, input_id, cls) {
  div(
    class = "summary-card",
    h3(title),
    p(class = "sub", sprintf("Number of the %d guidelines", n_guidelines)),
    lapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i)
      bar_row(df$value[i], df$n[i], max(df$n), cls = cls,
              action = sprintf("esib.filter('guidelines', '%s', '%s')", input_id, js_str(df$value[i])),
              hint = "Show these guidelines in the guideline key"))
  )
}

explore_card <- function(title, desc, key, cls = "") {
  tags$button(type = "button", class = paste("explore-card", cls), onclick = sprintf("esib.show('%s')", key),
              div(class = "t", title), div(class = "d", desc), div(class = "go", HTML("Open &rarr;")))
}

kpi <- function(num, lab) div(class = "kpi", div(class = "num", num), div(class = "lab", lab))

# ---- page -------------------------------------------------------------------
tagList(

    explore_card("Reporting items", sprintf("All %s items, reproduced verbatim from each checklist.", format(n_items, big.mark = ",")), "items", "teal"),
    explore_card("Concepts", "The standardised reporting concepts that each item asks for.", "concepts", "orange"),
    explore_card("Variables and values", "What each column means and the values you can filter on.", "variables", "green")
  ),
  div(
    class = "summary-grid",

      class = "summary-card wide",
      h3("Guidelines by year of first publication"),
      p(class = "sub", sprintf("%d guidelines, %d to %d", n_guidelines, year_min, year_max)),
      div(class = "col-chart",
          lapply(seq_len(nrow(per_year)), function(i) {
            div(class = paste("col", if (per_year$n[i] == 0) "empty"),
                title = sprintf("%d: %d guideline%s", per_year$year[i], per_year$n[i], if (per_year$n[i] == 1) "" else "s"),
                span(class = "n", if (per_year$n[i] > 0) per_year$n[i]),

                  action = sprintf("esib.filter('guidelines', 'methodology_guidelines', '%s')", js_str(by_methodology$value[i])),
                  hint = "Show these guidelines in the guideline key"))),
    div(
      class = "summary-card",

      lapply(seq_len(nrow(items_by_section)), function(i)
        bar_row(as.character(items_by_section$section[i]), items_by_section$items[i], max(items_by_section$items),

      lapply(seq_len(nrow(top_concepts)), function(i)
        bar_row(top_concepts$e[i], top_concepts$n_guidelines[i], n_sets, cls = "orange", wide = TRUE,

```

::: {.callout-note title="How to use the data tables"}

- **Guideline key** links each guideline ID to the guideline's name and references. **Reporting items** holds every item verbatim. **Concepts** holds the standardised reporting concepts extracted from each item. **Variables and values** explains each column and lists the values available for filtering.
- Drop-down filters above each table combine with AND logic. The boxes under each column heading filter that column; the search box searches all columns.
- **Download filtered** exports the rows currently matched by your filters and searches. The links under each table give the full CSV files.
- The reporting item and concept tables can be joined on `checklist_item_id`; all three tables can be joined on `study_id` (shown as *Guideline ID*).
:::

## Guideline key

```{r guidelines-data}
fmt_ref <- function(title, journal, year, doi) {
  doi <- str_squish(doi)
  doi_html <- if_else(is.na(doi) | doi == "", "",
                      sprintf(' <a href="https://doi.org/%s" target="_blank">doi:%s</a>', doi, doi))
  journal <- if_else(is.na(journal) | str_squish(journal) %in% c("", "NA"), "", paste0(" <em>", str_squish(journal), "</em>."))
  sprintf("%s.%s %s.%s", str_remove(str_squish(title), "[.]$"), journal, year, doi_html)
}

checklists_per_guideline <- data |>
  group_by(study_id) |>
  summarise(checklists = paste(sort(unique(checklist)), collapse = "; "), .groups = "drop")
items_per_guideline <- items_real |> count(study_id, name = "n_items")

guideline_key <- study |>
  mutate(ref = fmt_ref(title, journal, year, DOI)) |>
  group_by(study_id) |>
  summarise(
    title = first(str_squish(title)),
    n_publications = n(),
    references = paste0('<ul class="refs">', paste0("<li>", ref, "</li>", collapse = ""), "</ul>"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(guideline_attrs, by = "study_id") |>
  left_join(checklists_per_guideline, by = "study_id") |>
  left_join(items_per_guideline, by = "study_id") |>
  mutate(across(c(guideline_type, methodology, discipline), as.factor)) |>
  arrange(year, study_id) |>
  select(
    `Guideline ID` = study_id,
    Guideline = guideline_name,
    Title = title,
    Year = year,
    Type = guideline_type,
    Methodology = methodology,
    Discipline = discipline,
    Checklists = checklists,
    Items = n_items,
    Publications = n_publications,
    References = references
  )

sd_guidelines <- SharedData$new(guideline_key, key = ~`Guideline ID`, group = "guidelines")
```

<p class="lead-text">Each guideline ID (`study_id` in the data files) is usually the first author's surname (or organisation) and the year of the guideline's first publication. Use this key to see which guideline an ID refers to. Guidelines published in several journals list every publication under References.</p>

## Variables and values

<p class="lead-text">Every column in the three tables, the column name it has in the CSV files, and, for categorical variables, every value it can take (with the number of rows that have it). Use these values in the drop-down filters and the column filter boxes.</p>

```{r variables}
value_chips <- function(x, order = NULL) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  tb <- table(x)
  lv <- if (is.null(order)) names(sort(tb, decreasing = TRUE)) else intersect(order, names(tb))
  div(class = "chips", lapply(lv, function(v) span(class = "chip", v, tags$small(format(tb[[v]], big.mark = ",")))))
}
free_text <- function(x, what = "values") {
  span(class = "free-text", sprintf("Free text: %s distinct %s.", format(n_distinct(x[!is.na(x)]), big.mark = ","), what))
}
range_text <- function(x) span(class = "free-text", sprintf("Whole number from %d to %d.", min(x, na.rm = TRUE), max(x, na.rm = TRUE)))

var_row <- function(label, column, description, values) {
  tags$tr(tags$td(class = "v", label, tags$code(column)), tags$td(description), tags$td(values))
}
var_table <- function(...) {
  tags$table(class = "var-table",
             tags$thead(tags$tr(tags$th("Variable"), tags$th("Description"), tags$th("Values"))),
             tags$tbody(...))
}

tagList(
  h3("Guideline key"),
  var_table(
    var_row("Guideline ID", "study_id", "Identifier for the guideline: usually the first author's surname (or organisation) and the year of first publication.",
            span(class = "free-text", sprintf("%d IDs; see the Guideline key tab.", n_guidelines))),
    var_row("Guideline", "guideline_name", "Short name of the guideline (its acronym where it has one).",
            span(class = "free-text", sprintf("%d names; see the Guideline key tab.", n_distinct(guideline_attrs$guideline_name)))),
    var_row("Title", "title", "Title of the guideline's first publication.", free_text(study$title, "titles")),
    var_row("Year", "year", "Year of the guideline's first publication.", range_text(guideline_attrs$year)),
    var_row("Type", "guideline_extension", "Whether the guideline is new (original) or builds on another guideline.", value_chips(guideline_attrs$guideline_type)),
    var_row("Methodology", "methodology_category", "Type of evidence synthesis the guideline covers.", value_chips(guideline_attrs$methodology)),
    var_row("Discipline", "discipline", "Field the guideline was developed for.", value_chips(guideline_attrs$discipline)),
    var_row("Checklists", "checklist", "Checklists published with the guideline (for example a main checklist and an abstract checklist).",
            span(class = "free-text", sprintf("%d checklists; see the Checklist variable below.", n_checklists))),
    var_row("Items", "-", "Number of reporting items in the guideline's checklists.", span(class = "free-text", "Count.")),
    var_row("Publications / References", "journal, DOI", "Every publication of the guideline (journal, year and DOI).", span(class = "free-text", sprintf("%d publications.", n_publications)))
  ),
  h3("Reporting items"),
  var_table(
    var_row("Guideline ID", "study_id", "Guideline the item comes from (see Guideline key).", span(class = "free-text", sprintf("%d IDs.", n_distinct(items_real$study_id)))),
    var_row("Guideline", "guideline_name", "Short name of the guideline.", span(class = "free-text", "See Guideline key.")),
    var_row("Checklist", "checklist", "Checklist the item belongs to; a guideline can have several.", value_chips(items_real$checklist, order = sort(unique(items_real$checklist)))),
    var_row("Item ID", "checklist_item_id", "Unique identifier for the item; joins items to concepts.", free_text(items_real$checklist_item_id, "IDs")),
    var_row("Item no.", "reporting_item_number", "Item number as printed in the checklist.", free_text(items_real$reporting_item_number)),
    var_row("Reporting item", "reporting_item", "Item text, verbatim.", free_text(items_real$reporting_item, "items")),
    var_row("Section", "standardised_section", "Standardised manuscript section.", value_chips(items_real$standardised_section, order = section_levels)),
    var_row("Section in guideline", "section", "Section heading used by the guideline.", free_text(items_real$section, "headings")),
    var_row("Topic", "topic", "Topic heading used by the guideline.", free_text(items_real$topic, "headings")),
    var_row("Language", "language", "Language of the checklist.", value_chips(items_real$language)),
    var_row("Methodology", "methodology_category", "Taken from the guideline (see Guideline key).", value_chips(guideline_attrs$methodology)),
    var_row("Discipline", "discipline", "Taken from the guideline (see Guideline key).", value_chips(guideline_attrs$discipline)),
    var_row("Year", "year", "Year of the guideline's first publication.", range_text(guideline_attrs$year))
  ),
  h3("Concepts"),
  var_table(
    var_row("Guideline ID, Guideline, Checklist, Item ID, Reporting item", "study_id, guideline_name, checklist, checklist_item_id, reporting_item",
            "As in the reporting items table.", span(class = "free-text", "See above.")),
    var_row("Concept", "standardised_reporting_item_elements", "Standardised reporting concept requested by the item.",
            span(class = "free-text", sprintf("%s distinct concepts; the most common are shown on the Overview tab.", format(n_concept_uniq, big.mark = ",")))),
    var_row("Section", "standardised_section", "Standardised manuscript section of the concept.", value_chips(concept_real$standardised_section, order = section_levels)),
    var_row("Subsection", "standardised_subsection", "Standardised subsection within the manuscript section.", value_chips(concept_real$standardised_subsection, order = sort(unique(concept_real$standardised_subsection)))),
    var_row("Methodology, Discipline, Year", "methodology_category, discipline, year", "Taken from the guideline (see above).", span(class = "free-text", "See above."))
  )
)
```

<div class="table-note">Categorical values have been capitalised consistently on this page (for example "English", not "english"). The "as shown here" downloads use the same values; the original files are unchanged.</div>

## Cite and reuse

If you use these data, please cite the accompanying paper (the full reference will be added on publication) and the data page:

::: {.cite-box}
**Paper**<br>
Morrison K, Ivimey-Cook ER, Lagisz M, Mizuno A, Santana MS, Santos ESA, Sánchez-Tójar A, Simpson ZP, Grainger M, Macura B, Nakagawa S. An item bank of reporting items and concepts in evidence synthesis reporting guidelines. *In preparation.* Study registration: <`r osf_url`>.
:::

::: {.cite-box}
**Data page and data**<br>
Morrison K, Ivimey-Cook ER, Lagisz M, Mizuno A, Santana MS, Santos ESA, Sánchez-Tójar A, Simpson ZP, Grainger M, Macura B, Nakagawa S (`r this_year`). Evidence synthesis reporting item bank [data set and interactive data page]. <`r page_url`>. Data and code: <`r github_url`>. Accessed `r last_updated`.
:::

BibTeX:

```{r bibtex}
#| results: asis
fence <- strrep("`", 3)
bib <- c(
  paste0("@misc{morrison_item_bank_", this_year, ","),
  "  author       = {Morrison, K. and Ivimey-Cook, E. R. and Lagisz, M. and Mizuno, A. and Santana, M. S. and Santos, E. S. A. and S{\\'a}nchez-T{\\'o}jar, A. and Simpson, Z. P. and Grainger, M. and Macura, B. and Nakagawa, S.},",
  "  title        = {Evidence synthesis reporting item bank},",
  paste0("  year         = {", this_year, "},"),
  "  howpublished = {Data set and interactive data page},",
  paste0("  url          = {", page_url, "},"),
  paste0("  note         = {Data and code: ", github_url, "}"),
  "}"
)
cat(paste0(fence, "bibtex"), bib, fence, sep = "\n")
```
